## What changed and why

Link the case ID and tracking issue. Identify the owning component and describe the problem addressed.

## Evidence and validation

State the tested versions/commits, acceptance check, result, and public evidence. Mark unrun checks explicitly. For documentation-only changes, explain which evidence supports the correction.

## Rollback and limitations

Describe the scoped reversal or state that only documentation changed. Preserve unresolved alternatives and evidence boundaries.

## Review

- [ ] The case file and human/JSON indexes agree.
- [ ] Observations, hypotheses, containment, synthetic tests, and confirmed fixes remain distinct.
- [ ] No private diagnostics, credentials, local paths, endpoints, personal content, or unlicensed source are included.
- [ ] Executable adapter changes are linked to their existing owner rather than copied here.
